summary: Frontend-only verification of the reposition of CornerWeb spiderwebs from top to bottom corners on /cementerio. Logged in via 'Probar cuenta demo', confirmed Modo Halloween ON by default, scrolled to the bottom of [data-testid='cementerio-page'] and verified exactly TWO CornerWeb SVGs anchored to bottom-left and bottom-right with the correct CSS mirroring. Verified no console errors, no horizontal scrollbar, cards still open the profile modal, toggle removes/restores webs, and the state persists across reload. Vine canopy + side vines regression pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Cementerio.jsx is ~660 lines and mixes many concerns (cards, modals, panels, sockets). Consider splitting into smaller components (ProfileModal, FossilPanel, HallOfFame, modals) into their own files for maintainability.
test_credentials: Demo account via 'Probar cuenta demo' button on /cementerio.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two CornerWeb SVGs render as direct children of [data-testid='cementerio-page'] with classes 'absolute bottom-6 left-0 z-30 opacity-60' (bl, scaleY(-1)) and 'absolute bottom-6 right-0 z-30 opacity-60' (br, scale(-1,-1)). To validate presence, scroll to bottom of page then evaluate querySelectorAll on direct-child SVGs. Halloween state is persisted in localStorage key 'cem_halloween' ('1' or '0').
